caption: popcap's midas puzzle - spin coins into golden paths that feed the king's greed.
about: Talismania deluxe gives king midas a puzzle engine: coins spawn as snake-shaped tokens, you rotate them on a grid and connect matching endpoints to turn them into gold that flows to the buildings waiting for it. The golden-touch frame is the tutorial - everything routes through the same spin-and-connect law, deeper than it looks, with bonus rounds on the side.

The steam listing is the deluxe build still sold under popcap's ea-era catalog. It was also the last original design popcap shipped in the deluxe era, which makes it a small historical marker as well as a good puzzle.
